contract.training: H=sum(x*x^T)+ridge*I; theta=H^-1 sum(x*y); ridge is a multiple of 1/16, unpublished
contract.oracle: mean=q^T theta+e_m; predictive_variance=noise_variance*(1+q^T H^-1 q)*(1+e_v); noise_variance unpublished; outputs rounded to 12 significant digits; e_m,e_v small zero-mean Gaussian
contract.query_domain: q=features(raw) for the listed raw vector; queries were not chosen by you
contract.history: snapshots are unordered; some are consecutive versions of one service, one may be a stale redeploy; ingest batches are unordered and unlabeled; the deletion was fulfilled by exact retraining in the same release as one ingest batch
contract.deletion: deleted records are a unique subset of candidates, once each; count unrecorded
contract.encoding: ASCII-sort record-id:label strings for every deleted record
